title: AI Product Content by Industry | Aidreamcapes
description: Browse AI product content by industry, from skincare and sneakers to snacks and home decor. See which photos and videos suit what you sell, then make yours.
h1: AI Product Content by Industry, Matched to What You Sell
lead: Pick your category to see which photos and short videos matter most for it, plus practical ideas you can make from a single product photo.
secondary_keywords: product video ideas for online stores
AI images for small online shops
intro: Every category sells a little differently. A serum buyer wants to see texture, a sneaker buyer checks the sole, and a coffee buyer wants to watch the pour. These pages sort ideas by what you sell, so you can start with the shots that answer your shoppers' real questions instead of guessing. Each one covers the photos and short videos worth making first, the details to get right in your upload, and questions other sellers in that category often ask.

faq.q: What if my products fit more than one category?
faq.a: Start with the page closest to your top seller, then borrow ideas from the others. A candle shop, for example, might use home ideas for living room shots and wellness ideas for an evening wind-down post.

faq.q: My category isn't listed. Can I still use Aidreamcapes?
faq.a: Yes. The tools aren't limited to these categories. Pet supplies, toys, stationery, and outdoor gear sellers can make white background photos, lifestyle scenes, and short video ads the same way.

faq.q: Do I need professional product photos to get started?
faq.a: No. A clear phone photo is enough. Make sure nothing is cut off at the edges, shoot in soft daylight, and leave the background simple so the item stands out.
